page.overview:
What is Terrakion?

This Terrakion is a /-type Pokémon and a member of The Swords of Justice.

As a solid -type Pokémon, Terrakion appeared as mentor to Keldeo. He always helped Keldeo and saved it from Kyurem.

He appeared along with other Musketeers living in peaceful environment. Keldeo trained with him in order to learn Sacred Sword. He was part of Sword of Justice. He also battled Kyurem in order to save Keldeo.
